Define cache for figures and tables

Source: R/cache.R
pub_cache.Rd

Holds rendered figures and tables for reuse by the render functions that get it as their cache argument (pub_html(), pub_render(), pub_markdown() and the viewer).

Usage

pub_cache(dir = NULL, max_entries = 500L)

Arguments

dir

Directory for the image files, or NULL for a new temporary directory of the R session.

max_entries

Maximum number of cached figures and tables.

Value

A pub_cache object (an environment, so it is updated in place).

Details

What is cached

Two kinds of entries are cached:

  • figures: image files in dir, used by every output format. The key combines the figure's stamp (step, partition key and run time, see pub_meta()), a hash of the figure and its metadata and the device settings.

  • tables: their HTML (in memory), used by HTML output. The key is a hash of the table and its font size.

Beyond max_entries entries the least recently used ones (and their files) are removed.

See also

pub_html(), pub_render()

Examples

cache <- pub_cache()
cache
#> <pubflow render cache> 0 of at most 500 entries, files in '/tmp/RtmppvlQaN/pubflow-cache-1d6945d6dd1'
